description:
Details of one MAX Bot API method (query params, body, limits, gotchas, docs link) or the full method list.

    Also tells when a method was removed or restricted (GET /chats, POST /chats/{chatId}/members).

lang.description: Answer language: 'en' English, 'ru' Russian. Pick the user's language; default ru (or XONTA_MAX_LANG)
lang.title: Lang

path.description: Path like '/messages', '/chats/{chatId}/pin' or a concrete one '/chats/-123/pin'
path.title: Path

verb.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE. Omit to list all endpoints
verb.title: Verb

name: max_endpoint_info
